silhouette.reason: Horns, open jaw with teeth, dorsal spines, membrane wings with fingers and a long tail: the dragon reads in black from every view.
fixes: a spade or ridge on the tail tip so the TOP view has a signature end

proportions.reason: Neck reads short and thick for the 8.9 m body, and the tail root is thinner than the hips in SIDE.
fixes: lengthen the neck chain by one vertebra (neck.ts); thicken the tail root to match the hips (tail.ts)

materials.reason: Red hide, pale belly and bone horns separate, membranes are slightly translucent-looking; but the hide is mostly flat red with no scale pattern except a stamped dot patch on the shoulder that reads as a decal.
fixes: scale pattern across the back and flanks (not one patch) at LOD0
roughness split: glossy eyes and teeth, rough membrane

detail.reason: Teeth, spines, wing fingers and veins, claws and belly plates hold at the hero distance; the trunk surface is smooth between them.
fixes: stamped scale rows on the neck and back; crisper belly-plate edges

wear.reason: Ragged trailing edges on the membranes only; no scars, no chipped horn tips, no soot at the jaw.
fixes: scars on the flank, chipped horn tips and soot around the jaw

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps wings, horns and colour blocks; the body faceting and a lighter flank patch show at the switch.
fixes: more rings on the LOD2 tail and neck; average the colour per face

technical.reason: QA clean; 149k / 28k / 4k triangles over 7 draws: LOD0 is heavier than the detail it shows.
fixes: cap LOD0 near 120k by coarsening the hidden belly and inner-leg sculpt cells
